name: Lykke
rootCause: Lykke, the zero-fee crypto exchange, was suspected to be exploited, which resulted in a loss of assets worth over $22.4 million. The root cause of the exploit is unknown at the moment, and the team has yet to acknowledge the occurrence of the exploit. The stolen assets include roughly 158 BTC from the Bitcoin network and over 2161 ETH from the Ethereum Mainnet, among other assets.

descriptions.text: Lykke, the zero-fee crypto exchange, was suspected to be exploited, which resulted in a loss of assets worth over $22.4 million. The root cause of the exploit is unknown at the moment, and the team has yet to acknowledge the occurrence of the exploit. The stolen assets include roughly 158 BTC from the Bitcoin network and over 2161 ETH from the Ethereum Mainnet, among other assets.

On June 4, 2024, Lykke Exchange suffered a hot wallet key compromise across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Bitcoin Cash, resulting in a loss of approximately $22M. The breach was concealed for two days before public disclosure. Lykke halted operations and filed for bankruptcy, with funds attributed to North Korea's Lazarus Group. Specific technical details and affected wallet addresses are not publicly available. Hot wallet signing keys were compromised, enabling attackers to execute unauthorized withdrawals.
